findings.title: Authoritative room/lobby state is process-local and lost on restart
evidence: server.ts:751-765 restoreLiveOpsOverrides() re-applies only the durable publish override
replayStore/room sims are in-process; no external session store
findings.impact: A restart drops active rooms and in-flight sessions; the operator publish freeze survives restart (mitigated), but gameplay disruption is expected during a redeploy.
findings.recommendation: Document the maintenance-window expectation in the deploy runbook, and drain rooms before recreate (stop_grace_period is 30s).
findings.note: Prior ARCH-P2-003; the publish-override half is now durable.

report: Topology: Next.js web (3000) + authoritative realtime (3001) + OTel collector + nginx, single certified host, internal bridge network. Compose now sets cpus/mem_limit/pids_limit on every app-facing service, read_only roots, no-new-privileges, cap_drop ALL, and json-file log rotation (ARCH-P2-001 fixed). Readiness is dependency-aware and cached (ARCH-P2-002 fixed, server.ts:719-743). Residual: authoritative lobby/LiveOps state is process-local; the durable LiveOps publish override is re-applied at boot (server.ts:751-765), which mitigates the operator freeze case but rooms/replay caches are still lost on restart.
